coexistence_inventory.description: Protected parallel workflow for older customers (FR-CO-02, OPD-15). Exposed read-only; the product cannot alter, disable or retire it.

deviations.justification: SQL report 1 total inflated by LEFT JOIN events fan-out (BB-08); new month_end_total sums cases once. F10-2 DV-01 (fix).

Legacy marks every REPLAY as DUPLICATE (BB-05); new distinguishes identical vs changed content. F10-2 DV-02 (fix). New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged. Observed on the shipped feed: 67 REPLAY rows -> NOOP_DUPLICATE, 0 REVISED_CONFLICT (no changed-content replay exists in FX-BASE125; the changed-content path is covered by TST-INT-01..08). Legacy 64 vs 67: 3 REPLAY rows fail legacy key/schema checks first (BD-02).

Legacy rejects negative quantity; new keeps it flagged for review. F10-2 DV-03 (change of class). New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged. 161 partner items carry NEGATIVE_VALUE and are kept (3 in queue flagged_value; the rest carry a higher-precedence reason), none rejected (BD-03).

Legacy Java silently skips blank amounts; new reports UNPARSABLE_AMOUNT (quarantine). F10-2 DV-04 (fix). New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged. Vendor tiny CSV: 10 rows QUARANTINED UNPARSABLE_AMOUNT, 2,390 rows kept (BD-04).
Legacy JS tolerance with 'abc'/null is undefined behaviour; new rejects invalid input. F10-2 DV-05 (fix).
Unknown region/year default 999999 kept but marked defaulted. F10-2 DV-06 (additive).

Legacy reconcile overwrites processing_status in place; new appends outcomes and leaves the legacy table untouched. F10-2 DV-07 (fix). New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged. DV-07a (Stage 17 PCH-35 text extension): the new value also includes the outcome classification: EXCEPTION 8,109 (UNMATCHED_REF 7,903, NO_BUSINESS_KEY 206 - see DV-10), QUARANTINED 223, VALIDATED 165, VALIDATED_WITH_FLAGS 3, NOOP_DUPLICATE 67 (BD-07).
Night-shift join multiplies rows (118 distinct objects in first 500); new evaluates per entity (500 distinct in first 500). F10-2 DV-08 (fix).

Legacy counts invalid gateway events but does not store them; new stores them in quarantine. F10-2 DV-09 (fix). Stage 20 label correction (Stage 17 PCH-35, OD-24): the built intake uses the Stage 12 code MISSING_ENVELOPE_FIELD, not 'envelope_invalid' (BD-09). New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged.

Legacy reconcile never checks ref_id, so most partner rows end ACCEPTED; the hub links ref_id to the 125 baseline cases by exact key (BEH-INT-08, AC-INT-18): 168 linked, 7,903 EXCEPTION/UNMATCHED_REF, 206 EXCEPTION/NO_BUSINESS_KEY. Specified behaviour (PRD baseline OD-22) registered by Stage 17 PCH-35 / OD-24 as proposed DV-10 (BD-07). Registration only, not approval. New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged.

Legacy JS threshold lookup matches partial years by startsWith (threshold('APAC', 202 / 2 / '') -> 15000, the 2022 row); the rule service requires the 4-digit year and returns 999999 with defaulted = true (DEV-29, RTD-41). No Stage 7 golden captures it: the legacy value is the documented INC-04 S05 live node run (docs/15-modernization/transformation-log.md DEV-29). Registered by Stage 17 PCH-35 / OD-24 as proposed DV-11 (BD-10). Registration only, not approval. New value restated in Stage 20 as the OBSERVED output of the built module on FX-BASE125 (DW-04, golden-compare provider 'observed'); the behaviour described is unchanged.

note: Stage 20 register (DW-05 / FAC-06): DV-01..DV-11, every row 'proposed' with an empty approval_ref (registration, not approval; OD-S12-13 open; HAR-06). Supersedes seed_inc02.json for new stores; rows of an existing store that are still byte-identical to the INC-02 seed and still proposed are refreshed to this text (hub.coexistence.register.seed). legacy_value/new_value are canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact). Synthetic, unvalidated.
